provider: GeoMermaids / OpenStreetMap contributors and separately credited infrastructure providers
api_version: GMWID latest (weekly mutable) ODbL branch only; gmwid/nsta and separate licensed provider trees explicitly excluded

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only, no executable source request or adapter permission. The only contemplated future read is original provider attribution/coverage metadata on fixed gmwid/latest paths, not a layer file. No arbitrary layer, bbox, query, parquet bulk, member-state insurer mapping, gmwid/nsta/ or abandoned/ requests. Any future fetch must review original source automation terms and hash/size budgets first.

response_contract.format: Coverage metadata JSON and open-build attribution text, not the original GeoParquet asset rows or restricted sidecar data.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Provider advertises 27 global infrastructure layers and per-row origin provenance. Weekly latest builds are non-frozen and incomplete by region/type. OSM and enrichment rows cannot be treated as independent double-counted infrastructure; the same physical site can appear across sources. These inventories are not building insurance portfolios, insurer allocations, TIVs, physical hazard or vulnerability models. Source vintage, ODbL share-alike/attribution, national source obligations and deduplication are separate requirements.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Provider illustrates anonymous online Parquet and coverage access but has not been checked for automation rate limits, commercial polling, server load or downstream asset bulk redistribution; no executable probe allowed until separately reviewed.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: gmwid/latest is rebuilt weekly; catalogue URLs are mutable. Review and pin build date, exact source country/layer and original content SHA before any model staging. The noncommercial gmwid/nsta tree must never be UNION-ed into a commercial model by this access contract.

rights_and_policy.notes: Publisher explicitly states gmwid/latest ODbL 1.0 (commercial use with attribution/share-alike) and distributes UK NSTA-only data separately under noncommercial source terms; these are NOT an interchangeable product. ODbL obligations and attribution must be assessed for any published derived database; source-country enrichment provenance remains per row. No automatic server polling or republishing rights inferred. A separate access contract and human approval would be required for any gmwid/nsta use.

notes: Static documented-only source-access contract for the existing GMWID candidate. Exact publisher licensing split reviewed 2026-11-14. No original GeoParquet/coverage bytes, strict API receipt, downstream commercial model admission, insurer portfolio or database write carried out.
